preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
The dimensions of the grid are between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The elements of the array B are distinct and between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N * M over all test cases does not exceed 10^6
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: Output is a grid A of size N x M
postconditions.description: The output is a grid with N rows and M columns, where each element is an integer from the input array B.

postconditions.expression: Score of the grid is minimized
postconditions.description: The score of the grid is defined as the difference between the largest and smallest elements visited by the car, and the output grid minimizes this score.
